intent.description: Author, refactor, migrate, or troubleshoot Typst slide decks using @preview/touying:0.8.0 (Typst 0.15.0+). Use when creating or editing .typ presentations, multi-file globals.typ decks, built-in or custom themes, slide headings or #slide, incremental animations (#pause, #uncover, #only, #animate), speaker notes (#speaker-note, .pdfpc), or multi-mode export (presentation, handout, article), including Chinese and English requests (制作/创建/重构/排查/迁移 Typst Touying 幻灯片、演示文稿与讲义). Excludes non-Typst web or office slides (HTML, reveal.js, PPT, Marp), ordinary non-slide Typst papers or reports, and XeLaTeX thesis defense decks (academic-defense-beamer).
intent.job_to_be_done: Author, refactor, migrate, and troubleshoot Typst slide decks using @preview/touying:0.8.0 (Typst 0.15.0+) with multi-file architecture, multi-mode export, and compile-verified closing gates.
target_users: Researchers and engineers building technical slide decks
inputs: Deck outline, content, theme or migration requirements
outputs: Valid Touying 0.8.0 .typ source files (single-file or globals.typ + main.typ + sections)
Verified compile diagnostics under --warnings promote (or explicit missing evidence)
exclusions: Non-Typst HTML, reveal.js, PPT/pptx, or Marp slide decks
Ordinary non-presentation Typst documents without slide or dual article-mode intent
